sentences.text: 4. The learned Addl. P.P. has raised objection against the bail petition and has submitted that Case Diary may be produced.

5. The allegation against the petitioner is that Juroon (Engagement) was supposed to be held on 09.05.2023 and marriage was to be solemnized on 10.05.2023 but the petitioner failed to appear in Juroon.
The petitioner and the victim had a love affair for several years and the victim also was induced into having a physical relationship with the petitioner as he promised to marry the victim.
6. It is submitted that no case u/s 376 IPC was made out because the petitioner was 29 years old.
It is also submitted that at best a case u/s 417 may be made out which is a bailable offence.
7. I have considered the submissions that the petitioner has been behind bars for 40 days and further custodial detention for the purpose of investigation may not be required.
8. Considering all aspects, petition is allowed.

The petitioner is enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/- with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned CJM, Biswanath Chariali under the condition that the petitioner will not exercise threats to the witnesses and tamper with the evidence.
